model_output.verdict: A marketing coordinator with concrete campaign work, but nothing accounts for the time after March 2024.
write_up: This is a common situation: your marketing work is easy to follow, but your resume stops at March 2024. A recruiter will see email, events and social media at Juniper Outdoor Co., then may hesitate and move on because they can't tell what you've been doing since.
The email calendar is your best model. It names the work, its weekly rhythm and the 120,000-subscriber list. The trade shows and product copy also give a recruiter something concrete to hold onto.

Let's start by accounting honestly for the time after Juniper, then add a little more detail to the social posts and campaign reporting. Your earlier tasting events could use your particular contribution too.
